note: The canvas contract in one place: every webhook path the engine calls and every path the exports register. app/run_live.py reads the path it posts to from here, app/tools/make_n8n_exports.py writes the path it registers from here, and test_contracts.py fails the build if the export and this file disagree. Round 3 shipped these two out of step (engine posted cr/triage, export served triage), so the canvas path could never have worked; one file is the fix.
